pyramiding_rule: Absolute prohibition against pyramiding or placing multiple consecutive counter-trend or tight-cluster orders within a 5-minute window; scale-ins only permitted after a verified 15-pip structural breakout.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero execution permitted during ATR expansion spikes exceeding 2.5x the 20-period moving average unless confirmed by a multi-timeframe liquidity sweep.
profit_harvest_threshold: Disable premature micro-exits and enforce a minimum profit threshold trigger of +$15.00 before scaling out, utilizing a dynamic trailing stop that locks in gains only after crossing the asymmetric $15 boundary.
